[[Urgoz's Chest]] will spawn in [[Urgoz's Warren]], near [[Urgoz]], after his death. Each player in the party can open the chest once and will receive the following items.

==Location==
[[Echovald Forest]]
*[[Urgoz's Warren]]

==Urgoz's Chest drops==
''Drop research is ongoing, and may be found [[Urgoz's Chest/Research|here]].''

*Three [[Amber Chunk]]s (6 Amber Chunks in [[Hard mode]])

*One [[Mystical Summoning Stone]]

*One [[Passage Scroll to Urgoz's Warren]] (Hard mode only)

*One of the following (two in Hard mode):
**A [[Item rarity|rare]] [[inscribable]] item, which may be one of the following items that are only available from this chest or [[Kanaxai's Chest]]:
***[[Ceremonial Spear]]
***[[Crab Claw Maul]]
***[[Draconic Scythe]]
***[[Pronged Fan]]
***[[Serpentine Scepter]]
**A [[unique item]] unique to this chest:
***[[Urgoz's Flatbow]]
***[[Urgoz's Longbow]]
***[[Urgoz's Shortbow]]

== Notes ==
*This chest was added in the [[Game_updates/20070524|24 May 2007 update]].
